name: Full width 174 mm (C)
description: Style measured from open-access research figures in evidence set C and the publisher's stated artwork requirements, at the stated full-page width of 174 mm. Changes typography, line weights, palette, legend and axis geometry only. Not an official template.

experimental.evidence_summary: 51 open-access papers; visual review of panels plus typeset-PDF measurements where available; official requirements audited 2026-09-16

derived_from.official_sources: Cell Press figure guidelines (cell.com/figureguidelines, Wayback capture 2025-09-11): 85 / 114 / 174 mm widths, Arial only, about 6-8 pt text, 0.5-1.5 pt lines, capital panel letters, >= 300 dpi colour, RGB; accessed 2026-09-16

experimental.width_source: OFFICIAL:Cell Press figure guidelines (cell.com/figureguidelines, Wayback capture 2025-09-11)

value_evidence.grid: SHARED:Nature no grid 96%/Science no grid 94%/Cell no grid 96%
value_evidence.palette_name: SHARED:colour-blind-aware categorical palette; corpus modes Nature saturated 39%/Science mixed 40%/Cell saturated 32%; OFFICIAL: Nature figure guide requires an accessible palette
value_evidence.text_color: OBSERVED:axis and tick text black in the reviewed panels; publishers require standard fonts in black

value_evidence.tick_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.errorbar_line_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.bar_edge_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.tick_length: ESTIMATED:2.5 pt, about half the tick-label height
value_evidence.marker_edge_width: ESTIMATED:0.4 pt - a visible but light edge; marker edges were 'dark' or 'none' in similar shares
value_evidence.grid_width: SHARED:grid is off; width kept light if a user turns it on
value_evidence.marker_size: ESTIMATED:corpus marker class 'small' (68% of coded panels) -> diameter about 0.8 x tick-label height -> 20.0 pt^2
value_evidence.marker_alpha: ESTIMATED:0.9 so overlapping observations remain distinguishable
value_evidence.errorbar_capsize: OBSERVED:modal error-bar style 'none'; short caps kept for legibility
value_evidence.legend_loc: OBSERVED:legends are most often absent or inside the axes (mode 'none')
value_evidence.legend_outside: OBSERVED:legends outside the axes are the minority; users move them per figure
value_evidence.formats: OFFICIAL:vector (PDF/EPS/AI) preferred by every publisher; PNG for review copies

notes: Cell: absolute text sizes taken from the publisher's stated range, not measured
